title: Fix ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, and ContactSection raw translation key rendering

requirements.text: In the ExportCargoSection component, fix all translation keys — 'exportCargo.sectionLabel' (currently rendering as 'EXPORTCARGO.SECTIONLABEL'), 'exportCargo.heading', 'exportCargo.subheading', 'exportCargo.highlight1Title', 'exportCargo.highlight1Desc', 'exportCargo.highlight2Title', 'exportCargo.highlight2Desc', 'exportCargo.highlight3Title', and 'exportCargo.highlight3Desc' — so they resolve to human-readable text instead of raw key strings. Ensure: (1) the JSX in ExportCargoSection.tsx calls the t() translation helper with the exact key names defined in translations.ts (verify casing matches exactly, e.g. 'exportCargo.sectionLabel' not 'EXPORTCARGO.SECTIONLABEL'); (2) in frontend/src/translations/translations.ts, all three language codes (en, hi, mr) have non-empty, plain human-readable string values for every one of these nine keys. English values must be: 'exportCargo.sectionLabel' = 'Export & Cargo', 'exportCargo.heading' = 'Global Exports', 'exportCargo.subheading' = a concise supporting sentence about TrueOrigin Exports' professional export and shipping capabilities, 'exportCargo.highlight1Title' = 'Export Documentation', 'exportCargo.highlight1Desc' = a concise description of TrueOrigin's export documentation readiness, 'exportCargo.highlight2Title' = 'Secure Packaging', 'exportCargo.highlight2Desc' = a concise description of packaging standards, 'exportCargo.highlight3Title' = 'Global Reach', 'exportCargo.highlight3Desc' = a concise description of international shipping capability. Corresponding Hindi and Marathi translations must also be present and human-readable. No raw key string, JSON object, escaped character, or template literal artifact may appear as visible text for any of these keys in any language mode.
acceptanceCriteria: ExportCargoSection renders 'Export & Cargo' (or translated equivalent) as the section label — never the raw string 'EXPORTCARGO.SECTIONLABEL'
exportCargo.heading renders as 'Global Exports' in English, with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
exportCargo.subheading renders as a readable sentence in all three language modes
All three highlight title/desc pairs (highlight1, highlight2, highlight3) render as readable English, Hindi, and Marathi text
No raw key string, escaped character, or JSON fragment is visible in the ExportCargoSection at any viewport size in any language mode
The translation keys in ExportCargoSection.tsx exactly match the keys defined in translations.ts (correct camelCase, no uppercase mismatch)

requirements.text: In the SocialMediaSection component, fix the translation keys 'social.sectionLabel' (currently rendering as 'SOCIAL.SECTIONLABEL') and 'social.heading' so they resolve to human-readable text instead of raw key strings. Ensure: (1) the JSX in SocialMediaSection.tsx calls the t() translation helper with the exact key names defined in translations.ts (verify casing matches exactly, e.g. 'social.sectionLabel' not 'SOCIAL.SECTIONLABEL'); (2) in frontend/src/translations/translations.ts, all three language codes (en, hi, mr) have non-empty, plain human-readable string values for both keys — 'social.sectionLabel' must resolve to 'Follow Us' (or equivalent section label) in English with corresponding Hindi and Marathi translations, and 'social.heading' must resolve to 'Our Latest Updates' (or equivalent heading) in English with corresponding Hindi and Marathi translations. No raw key string, JSON object, escaped character, or template literal artifact may appear as visible text for either of these keys in any language mode.
acceptanceCriteria: SocialMediaSection renders the section label as human-readable text (e.g., 'Follow Us') — never the raw string 'SOCIAL.SECTIONLABEL'
social.heading renders as a readable heading (e.g., 'Our Latest Updates') in English, Hindi, and Marathi
The translation keys in SocialMediaSection.tsx exactly match the keys defined in translations.ts (correct camelCase)
No raw key string is visible in the SocialMediaSection in any language mode

requirements.text: In the ContactSection component, fix all translation keys — 'contact.heading', 'contact.subheading', 'contact.info.heading', 'contact.form.heading', and 'contact.form.submit' — so they resolve to human-readable text instead of raw key strings. Ensure: (1) the JSX in ContactSection.tsx calls the t() translation helper with the exact key names defined in translations.ts (verify casing and dot-notation path matches exactly); (2) in frontend/src/translations/translations.ts, all three language codes (en, hi, mr) have non-empty, plain human-readable string values for every one of these five keys. English values must be: 'contact.heading' = 'Get In Touch', 'contact.subheading' = a concise invitation for international buyers to reach out, 'contact.info.heading' = 'Contact Information', 'contact.form.heading' = 'Send an Enquiry', 'contact.form.submit' = 'Submit'. Corresponding Hindi and Marathi translations must also be present and human-readable. No raw key string, JSON object, escaped character, or template literal artifact may appear as visible text for any of these keys in any language mode.
acceptanceCriteria: ContactSection renders 'Get In Touch' (or translated equivalent) as the section heading — never the raw string 'contact.heading'
contact.subheading renders as a readable sentence in all three language modes
contact.info.heading renders as 'Contact Information' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
contact.form.heading renders as 'Send an Enquiry' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
contact.form.submit renders as 'Submit' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
The translation keys in ContactSection.tsx exactly match the keys defined in translations.ts (correct casing and nested dot paths)
No raw key string, escaped character, or JSON fragment is visible in the ContactSection in any language mode

constraints: Do not change any component other than ExportCargoSection.tsx, SocialMediaSection.tsx, ContactSection.tsx, and frontend/src/translations/translations.ts
Company name 'True Origin Company LLP' must never be translated and must remain in English across all language modes
All translation key names must use the exact camelCase dot-notation already established in translations.ts — do not introduce uppercase keys
nonGoals: Do not modify the NavBar, HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, QualityComplianceSection, Footer, ExportCertificationPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, or TermsAndConditionsPage components
Do not alter any visual layout, color palette, or typography in ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, or ContactSection
Do not add new features or sections to the website
